items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Then I left Hande's band, I went with Walter Pichon's band, and we played for Mamie Smith on the Vaudeville shows.

ctx.x: He lived over on the Gravier of Perdido along in that section, near the old Simon Call along in there. So I just wondered, no relation. No relation.
Then I left Hande's band, I went with Walter Pichon's band, and we played for Mamie Smith on the Vaudeville shows.
What was the blues singer? Blue singer. Who was on that band with drumming?
